supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Ridge extends horizontally beyond the lateral margins of the orbits.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Muzzle and mental regions display higher pixel luminosity (lighter) compared to the low-luminosity (darker) periocular and supraorbital regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thick lower lip with significant vertical depth and structural droop.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive hair thinning and alopecia across the superior cranial vault.
